CustomErrorLogs.QueryString: fields @timestamp, @message, @log, Name as Name, Layer as Layer, ExceptionCustomProperties.FunctionName as FunctionName, ExceptionCustomProperties.ErrorCode as ErrorCode, ExceptionCustomProperties.ErrorMessage as Message, TrackingId, @logStream | filter @message like "HCA-MPI-" | sort @timestamp desc

UsageMetrics.QueryString: fields @timestamp, ip, httpMethod, resourcePath, status, clientCertSubj, requestId | parse clientCertSubj /CN=(?<rawSystem>[^,]+)/ | stats count() as callCount, sum(status >= 400) as failedCount, sum(status < 400) as successCount, min(@timestamp) as firstSeen, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by rawSystem, ip | sort callCount desc

ApiTraffic.CallsPerDayQuery: filter @message like /Request starting/ | stats count(*) as apiCalls by bin(1d) as day | sort day desc
ApiTraffic.TopEndpointsQuery: filter @message like /Request starting/ and @message like /\/api\// | parse @message /(?<path>\/api\/[A-Za-z0-9._\-\/]+)/ | stats count(*) as calls by path | sort calls desc | limit 20
ApiTraffic.BusiestHoursQuery: filter @message like /Request starting/ | stats count(*) as apiCalls by bin(1h) as hour | sort apiCalls desc | limit 5
ApiTraffic.BusiestDaysQuery: filter @message like /Request starting/ | stats count(*) as apiCalls by bin(1d) as day | sort apiCalls desc | limit 10
ApiTraffic.BusiestMonthsQuery: filter @message like /Request starting/ | stats count(*) as apiCalls by datefloor(@timestamp, 1mo) as month | sort month desc | limit 6
